claims.statement: aksk-init is the per-repo lane that verifies global prerequisites (Node >=22, openspec/openwiki on PATH) before any repo write and never performs global installs; on missing tools it fails fast exit 2 directing to aksk-bootstrap

bootstrap-repo.mjs orchestrates a fixed idempotent sequence: scaffold .agents/skills and .agents/sessions plus seed AGENTS.md baseline first, then openspec init --tools none when openspec/ missing, then openwiki --init when openwiki/ missing, then attach_section for routing-note-template.md and lifecycle-template.md, then attach_wiki_contract; re-running on a fully initialized repo is a no-op

Preflight version diagnostics read caret ranges from aksk-bootstrap/references/versions.json as single source and print INSTRUCT: npm i -g @fission-ai/openspec@<range> openwiki@<range>; aksk-init does not maintain its own versions.json or hard-code @latest

Repo lane execution model: the aksk-init skill is the interactive orchestrator prompting [Y/n/skip] and the script bootstrap-repo.mjs is non-interactive, never blocks on stdin, supports --yes/--non-interactive/AKSK_YES=1 and falls back to INSTRUCT when no TTY

openwiki --init handling documents two paths (harness via agent+openwiki MCP/skill needs no extra key vs CLI needs OPENAI_API_KEY) and on non-zero exit logs CLI failed remediation but continues to marker attachments

init_agents_md.mjs seeds root AGENTS.md from vendored references/agents-md-baseline-template.md when missing, wraps it in AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE markers with provenance header (source URL, capture date, MIT notice, refresh pointer), and is idempotent via trailing-whitespace-per-line and newline-at-EOF normalization

init_agents_md.mjs fail-closed behavior: existing non-matching AGENTS.md with no flag exits 2 with no writes and prints replace-vs-combine prompt naming --replace and --combine; --replace overwrites with baseline; --combine never mutates original and stages existing.md, baseline.md and COMBINE.md under .agents/sessions/agents-md-combine/<timestamp>/

init_agents_md.mjs reads BEGIN/END markers from the template at runtime via markersOf() and validates them; directory target or mutually exclusive --replace+--combine or missing template exits 2 with no writes

attach_section.mjs is a generic N-section mechanism: template carries its own AKSK:<NAME>:BEGIN/END markers read at runtime, preserves all content outside markers, is idempotent and self-updating via trimmed compare then regex slice refresh, creates missing target file with only the section, and exits 2 on unknown template or missing marker pair

attach_wiki_contract.mjs appends the AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT section from references/wiki-contract-template.md between AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT markers to an existing openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md below existing content, never creates the file, is idempotent and self-updating via regex refresh, and fails fast exit 2 with verbatim prerequisite openwiki --init when file is missing

attach_wiki_contract.mjs is stub-aware: attaching below OpenWiki's default stub 'A code wiki for this repository.' is reported distinctly, and downstream skills treat a file without AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT markers as no-contract; content outside markers is never replaced

Fully bootstrapped AGENTS.md zoning is baseline (AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE by init_agents_md.mjs) → OpenWiki (OPENWIKI:START/END by OpenWiki tooling) → AKSK routing (AKSK:ROUTING) and lifecycle (AKSK:LIFECYCLE) by attach_section.mjs, each zone owned by one writer and ordered upstream-first

Optional repo-local skills default to inheriting global store (~/.agents/skills); with --local-skills the lane installs repo-locally via npx skills add without -g and records receipts, and partitioned INSTRUCT on failure prints only repo-scoped remaining commands without global-lane install commands
